items.rationale: The failed indoor supply pipe falls under §2.4.3(a). Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow standard-grade materials; comparable pipe, sealing, insulation and fittings total about €140 gross.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary labour at customary rates. The invoice lists one flat-rate unit without an hour count, so the supplied gross prior of €76 per billed unit gives €76 for the line.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows one travel charge per contractor per invoice regardless of the number of visits. This is the only travel charge on the repair invoice, estimated at €81 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying before reinstatement and allow one flat-rate deployment charge per drying operation. One operation at the comparable rate gives €439 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall opening
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(a) covers making good the necessary access opening, and §7.1.5 limits repainting to the disturbed patch. One localized repair at the comparable rate gives €453 gross.
